Top central banker warns AI could spark global economic downturn; Goldman Sachs sends blunt message on oil and economy

sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust across gold, rare earths, and uranium; iron ore sentiment weak ('roaches seeth'); policy shifts revive phosphate projects
sectors.implications: Positive for junior miners (GSG.AX, LND.AX, BKY.AX, IFU.AX, KSG.AX) on discovery momentum; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore demand and China concerns

sectors.trend: Property investor credit crash post-budget tax changes pressures NIM; rate expectation spike complicates lending outlook; Macquarie-KPMG $700m audit bid signals M&A activity
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from property credit contraction; MAC.AX benefits from audit sector consolidation

sectors.trend: Oil spikes on US-Iran strike; Beetaloo fracked gas online; Danish wind farm entry; oil giant retreats on clean energy
sectors.implications: Positive for Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) on gas; oil majors benefit from price spike; renewable developers (SUN.AX, LEM.AX) gain from Danish entry

sectors.trend: Qantas strike vote creates operational risk; weight-loss drug demand surges; 'dupe' brand trend accelerates; EV uptake rising
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces near-term disruption risk; CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX benefit from consumer health and retail trends

sectors.trend: House prices drop sharply; auction sentiment deteriorates; Bathla near collapse; negative gearing debate unresolved
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face valuation pressure; construction and developer names at risk

sectors.trend: Central banker warns AI contagion risk; Nvidia range-bound despite strong results; AI capex debate intensifies
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face sentiment overhang; global AI capex cycle may moderate

Australian housing market correction accelerating with credit contraction
RBA rate path uncertainty as market expectations spike
Resource exploration renaissance across rare earths, gold, uranium
AI systemic risk warning from central banks
Industrial action risk in transport sector
Corporate distress in property and gaming sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (US-Iran strike, Strait of Hormuz)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor oil above $90/bbl trigger; diversify away from oil-importing sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and property credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; favour defensive financials with diversified loan books

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate expectation spike / policy uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA communications; favour rate-sensitive sectors only if cut cycle confirmed
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor for strike escalation
Maintain diversification; avoid over-concentration in AI capex beneficiaries
Avoid speculative property and gaming names; monitor auditor going-concern flags

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy on oil spike and gas infrastructure buildout
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran strike supports oil; Beetaloo gas online; wind farm entry signals long-term transition

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to rare earths and critical minerals explorers
opportunities.rationale: Multiple breakthroughs (Barkly 99% extraction, Lindian feed, Infini uranium) signal policy tailwind and supply-chain security demand

opportunities.recommendation: Gold miners on safe-haven bid amid geopolitical risk
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran tensions and AI contagion fears support gold; Great Southern and Kaiser discoveries add optionality

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property REIT and developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Sharp house price decline, credit crash, and developer distress (Bathla) signal prolonged correction
Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/defensive allocation; avoid speculative small-caps
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX retreat on Wall Street slide; Star auditor concerns; broad risk-off tone

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open lower on Wall Street slide and oil-driven risk-off. Geopolitical premium supports energy but pressures transport and consumer. Housing data and rate expectation spike weigh on financials and REITs. Qantas strike adds idiosyncratic risk. Expect volatility above 1.5% intraday.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if geopolitical tensions de-escalate and RBA eases. Resource exploration pipeline (rare earths, uranium, gold) supports medium-term mining sector. Housing correction may stabilise by H2 2026. AI capex moderation could shift capital to healthcare and infrastructure.
